lines.text: Arabia is a desert land where wateris scare. Even if water is found it is not always
suitable for drinking. In olden days people had to travel long distances to.fetch
water and sometimes they had to remain without it for a day or even more. When
Hazrat Muhammad (raciJr) migrated to Medina, there was only one
well of sweet water in town. It was called Bair-e-Roma. The well was owned by a
Jew who sold its water ata high price.The companions of Rasool ()were
generally poor and found it hard to get water. One day they came to Hazrat
Muhammad (/aiJa) and apprised him about their condition. Hazrat
